SELECT u.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.name, t.id AS type_id, t.name AS type_name, u.code, p.id AS parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, COALESCE(ch.children_count, 0) AS children_count, COALESCE(ec.employee_count, 0) AS employee_count FROM units child LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = child.parent_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ch.parent_id, COUNT(*) AS children_count FROM units ch GROUP BY ch.parent_id ) ch ON ch.parent_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.unit_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.unit_id ) ec ON ec.unit_id = u.id WHERE child.id = #{id} OR child.parent_id IS NOT NULL
